title: Slope-intercept form
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item ('read RULE': the slope m and y-intercept b of y = RULE; 'line M B': the line y = Mx + B; 'line through X Y X Y': the line through two points), used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. Write equations in the form y = mx + b. Write fractions in simplest form.

items.prompt: For the line y = 4 − 3x, what is the slope m, and what is the y-intercept b?
A line has a slope of 5 and crosses the y-axis at (0, −2). Write its equation.
Write the equation of the line that passes through (0, 3) and (2, 11).
A line passes through (2, 1) and (4, 7). Write its equation in the form y = mx + b.
A phone plan costs $15 a month plus $5 for each GB of data you use. Write an equation for the monthly bill y (in dollars) when you use x GB.
Tasha says the line y = 2x + 7 has a slope of 7 and a y-intercept of 2. Is she right? Explain.
items.answer: m = 2, b = 7 (No: she swapped them; the slope is the number with x, and the y-intercept is the number added on)

items.prompt: For the line y = 6 − x, what is the slope m, and what is the y-intercept b?
A line goes down 4 for each 1 step to the right, and it crosses the y-axis at (0, 9). Write its equation.
Write the equation of the line through (0, −1) and (3, 5).
A line passes through (1, 9) and (3, 5). Write its equation in the form y = mx + b.
A taxi charges $3 when you get in, plus $2 for each mile. Write an equation for the total cost y (in dollars) of a ride that is x miles long.

Omar wants the equation of the line through (2, 5) and (4, 9). He finds the slope is 2, then writes y = 2x + 5, because 5 is the y of the first point. Is he right? Explain, and write the correct equation.
items.answer: y = 2x + 1 (No: 5 is the y-value at x = 2, not at x = 0; 5 = 2 × 2 + b, so b = 1)
